profiles.description: Fictional Acme Community Fund profile used by the sample dashboard.
profiles.aboutOrg: Acme Community Fund is a fictional 501(c)(3). It trains people, runs digital safety workshops, and manages grant-funded programs with local partners. It is not a real organization.
profiles.lookingFor: Nonprofit-eligible grants where the fictional fund could administer the award and hire delivery staff.
profiles.matchCriteria: Prefer no cash match, allowable indirect costs, operating expenses, and a nonprofit lead applicant.
profiles.poorFit: Pass on janitorial work, construction, manufacturing-only projects, for-profit-only eligibility, and invitation-only awards.
